mentions.name: Website Downtime Detector
mentions.description: A service that detects when websites go down, intended to be monetized and to serve as a learning stepping stone toward launching a full SaaS.
mentions.source_excerpt: A website down-time detector because I think I can make money off it and learn a few things so I can later launch a grown-up SaaS.
